description: Combines RDAP, GreyNoise/AbuseIPDB reputation, and Loggly traffic (1h/24h/30d counts, first/last seen, hosts, top paths — checked across every configured Loggly account unless `account` is given) into one normalized profile for an IP. Flags cross_domain_correlation when the IP shows activity in more than one account, which the bot-traffic-triage playbook treats as the single strongest escalation signal.
name: get_ip_context
title: Get IP Context
